name: PLANNING COMMISSION
agenda_text:
PLANNING COMMISSION
PLANNING COMMISSION
CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBER
38300 SIERRA HIGHWAY, SUITE B
PALMDALE, CALIFORNIA
Thursday JULY 12, 2018
07:00 P.M.
www.cityofpalmdale.org
WELCOME
NOTICE: This meeting will be simulcast live on Time Warner Channel 27 and at www.cityofpalmdale.org.
PLEASE NOTE:
For record keeping purposes, if you wish to make a statement regarding any item on the agenda, please complete the Speaker Slip located on the side table and deposit it with the Deputy City Clerk. (Note: There is a three-minute time limit per speaker imposed. Please stay within this limit.)
In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or services, please call the Planning Division at 661/267 5200 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.
Your courtesy is requested to help our meeting run smoothly. If you'll be kind enough to follow these simple rules, we can make the best possible use of your time and ours:
If you wish to speak on an item, please fill out a Speaker's Slip and deliver it to the Deputy City Clerk BEFORE the item is discussed.
Please refrain from public displays or outbursts such as unsolicited applause, comments or cheering.
Any disruptive activities that substantially interfere with the ability of the Planning Commission to carry out its meeting will not be permitted and offenders will be requested to leave the meeting.
Please turn off cell phones and electronic devices.
1. Call to Order
2. Pledge of Allegiance to the Flag
3. Administration of Oath to New and Reappointed Commissioners
4. Roll Call: Chair Nemeth Vice Chair French
Commissioners Avery, Olvera, and Ward
5. Review of Agenda
6. Motion to Waive Full Reading of all Resolutions on the Agenda for this Meeting
7. Public Comments on Consent Calendar Items and any Items not on the Agenda
8. Consent Calendar Approval of Minutes from the Regular Planning Commission Meeting of June 14, 2018
9. Public Hearings
9A. Conditional Use Permit 18-003 and Site Plan Review 18-019
Verizon Wireless, Applicant
A request to construct a major communication facility located at 2200 East Avenue S (Desert Lawn Memorial Park).
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt Resolution No. PC-2018-024, approving Conditional Use Permit (CUP) 18-003 and Site Plan Review (SPR) 18-019 and find that the project is Categorically Exempt from environmental proceedings pursuant to Section 15302, Class 2, of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) Guidelines. Justin Sauder, Assistant Planner
9A
9B. Conditional Use Permit 17-018 and Site Plan Review 18-016
Md7, LLC, Applicant
A request to re-establish a major wireless telecommunications facility previously approved through Conditional Use Permit (CUP) 02-12 located at 37140 47th Street East (Walmart Supercenter).
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt Resolution No. PC-2018-022, approving Conditional Use Permit (CUP) 17-018 and Site Plan Review 18-016 and find that the project will not result in any changes to the previously approved Mitigated Negative Declaration. Matthew Alcuran, Assistant Planner
9B
10. Staff Communications Development Update
Rob Bruce, Planning Manager
11. Planning Commission Communications
12. Adjournment to the Regular Planning Commission Meeting of Thursday, August 9, 2018, at 7:00 p.m., in the City of Palmdale Larry Chimbole Cultural Center Planning Commission Agenda
.
